customManagers.description: hk's pkl schema version lives in hk.pkl's package URL, separate from the binary in mise.toml. A major bump of one without the other fails `hk check` with an opaque pkl eval error. Keep both in the same PR.

packageRules.description: Everything that never reaches the release: devDependencies, the docs site and GitHub Actions. One weekly PR typed chore, which the release tool ignores, so merging it cuts no release.

@types/node tracks engines.node, not the newest LTS. Typechecking against 24's lib accepts APIs absent on the >=22.19.0 floor this package claims. Raise this ceiling in the same commit that raises engines.

peerDependency ranges ship in package.json. Widening one is a deliberate act: bump it, re-run the tests, type it feat: or fix: (CONTRIBUTING). The >= ranges mean Renovate skips them today anyway - this makes that structural instead of incidental.

Root npm dependencies ship in the published package, so a bump only reaches users through a release: release-please cuts one for fix. Own weekly PR, so a tooling bump never rides along. devDependencies, the docs site and GitHub Actions stay chore.
